scope: Verify complete paired TRDs, real ROM IRQ invariants and exact CPU replay.

irq.scope: Read-only physical field/IRQ correlation. Nearest listing row is only a locator, not a ROM disassembly.

audio_wait.formula: baseline: queue CPU + 73*full; prefetch: queue CPU + 100*busy + 118*idle
audio_wait.excludes: ordinary successful enqueue copy, other parser code, rendering, IRQ, ULA, ROM and physical latency
